title: Completed-Month Platform Fee Amount — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service
content:
The platform fee of a completed billing month of a Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service is the monthly platform fee of the tier the service holds on the fee debit day, billed for the whole month and booked as one platform fee entry for that billing month that points to no source entry, rounded half up to the cent. The fee is that monthly platform fee multiplied by every multiplier that applies, and then reduced once by the sum of every percentage that applies, the percentages being added together into one rate rather than applied one after another; the result is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, and a fee that comes to zero is not debited.

The billing month is the calendar month before the month of the fee debit day.

## Input, judgement, output

- **Input:** the tier held on the fee debit day, and that tier's monthly platform fee from the tariff.
- **Judgement:** the billing month is the month before the fee debit day's month; the whole of it is billed.
- **Output:** one platform fee entry for the billing month, pointing to no source entry, of the amount assembled as above, rounded half up to the cent once; nothing is booked when the amount is zero.

## Worked figures (hypothetical tariff amounts)

1. A tier whose monthly platform fee were 150.00: the completed-month fee is 150.00.
2. 150.00 with a multiplier of 0.4 and percentages of 8 and 6: 150.00 multiplied by 0.4 is 60.00; one rate of 14 percent gives 51.60.
3. 95.50 with a multiplier of 0.4 and one rate of 14 percent: 38.20 reduced by 14 percent is 32.852, rounded once at the end to 32.85.
4. A service that moved to a new tier on the first day of the month of the fee debit day holds the new tier on the fee debit day, so the completed month is billed at the new tier's monthly platform fee.
5. A tier whose monthly platform fee is 0.00: zero, and no entry is booked.
